story_overview: Minister Hyeon-sik and Jin-woo engage in a serious discussion within the Imperial Hall. Distraught, Hyeon-sik is plagued by a vision of a captured woman in tattered clothes, later seen grieving. The story culminates with Jin-woo riding a horse across a field, embarking on a seemingly urgent journey.
